payload.name: DNS Doctor - DNS & DMARC Tools
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check, fix and verify any domain's DNS, explained in plain English. DNS Doctor reads the records behind a domain, tells you what is wrong and why, and gives you the exact record to publish when there is one.

Scan a domain for email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mail routing (MX), DNS health, blacklists and domain and SSL certificate expiry. Look up any record on the domain's own nameservers, see whether a change has reached resolvers in six locations, check reverse DNS for a mail server, count SPF lookups, audit the third-party includes an SPF record trusts, and read a domain's registration: registrar, expiry, nameservers and locks.

DMARC records are generated and validated by a deterministic engine that follows the RFCs. The AI writes the explanation, never the record. SPF is diagnosed but never rewritten, because a changed SPF record can silently cut off a real sender. Nothing is applied to your DNS: you publish every record yourself.

Connect your DNS Doctor account to work with your monitored domains from ChatGPT: add a domain, check its ownership record, and read the alerts DNS Doctor raises for record changes, expiry, blacklisting, registrar or nameserver changes and new email senders seen in DMARC reports. It also tells you when that report evidence says it is safe to move DMARC from none to quarantine and then to reject.
payload.longDescription:
用通俗易懂的中文检查、修复并验证任何域名的DNS。DNS Doctor会读取域名背后的记录，告诉你哪里出错以及原因，并在有需要时提供要发布的具体记录。

扫描域名的邮件认证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC）、邮件路由（MX）、DNS健康状况、黑名单以及域名和SSL证书到期情况。可查询域名自有DNS服务器上的任意记录，查看变更是否已到达六个地区的解析器，检查邮件服务器的反向DNS，统计SPF查询次数，审计SPF记录信任的第三方包含项，并查看域名的注册信息：注册商、到期时间、DNS服务器和锁定状态。

DMARC记录由遵循RFC标准的确定性引擎生成并验证。AI会撰写解释说明，但不会直接生成记录。SPF会进行诊断但不会被重写，因为修改SPF记录可能无声地切断真实发件人。您的DNS不会被任何改动：所有记录需您自行发布。

将DNS Doctor账户连接至ChatGPT，即可在其中管理监控的域名：添加域名、检查所有权记录，并查看DNS Doctor针对记录变更、到期、黑名单、注册商或DNS服务器变更以及DMARC报告中出现的新发件人所发出的警报。它还会告知您何时报告证据显示可将DMARC策略从无（none）逐步调整为隔离（quarantine）最终到拒绝（reject）。

payload.description: 随时询问你的车队情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore your fleet data effortlessly through conversation. Wialon — the ultimate fleet digitalization solution tracking 4 million vehicles in 160 countries — brings your real-time operational insights directly into ChatGPT.

Simply ask questions about your vehicle statuses, trips, fuel activity, or geofences, and get clear, visual answers in seconds. It’s a faster, more intuitive way to stay on top of your operations, right where you already chat.

The app is read-only by design, ensuring a secure and transparent way to explore your data at any time.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话轻松探索车队数据。Wialon 是一款车队数字化解决方案，追踪 160 个国家/地区的 4 million 辆车辆，可将实时运营洞察直接带入 ChatGPT。

只需询问车辆状态、行程、燃油活动或地理围栏，即可在几秒钟内获得清晰直观的答案。无需离开熟悉的聊天界面，就能以更快捷、更直观的方式掌握运营情况。

该应用在设计上仅提供只读访问，让你随时以安全、透明的方式探索数据。

payload.name: Upload-Post
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload-Post helps users publish, schedule, analyze, and manage social media posts from ChatGPT. It supports video, photo, text, and document publishing; scheduling and queue management; analytics; profile management; Instagram comments and DMs; browser-based media staging; and FFmpeg media processing across connected social platforms.
payload.longDescription: Upload-Post帮助用户从ChatGPT发布、计划、分析和管理社交媒体帖子，支持视频、照片、文本和文档发布；日程安排和队列管理；数据分析；账号管理；Instagram评论和私信；基于浏览器的媒体预览；以及在连接的社交平台上使用FFmpeg进行媒体处理。

payload.name: Tailwind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tailwind helps users generate Pinterest Pin drafts from webpages, browse connected accounts, boards, board lists and board sections, create and manage boards, research public Pinterest group boards by topic, review drafts and recommended posting times, check an account's subscription status, manage a saved keywords list, schedule Pins, edit the copy on drafts and scheduled Pins, and delete unpublished Pins through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Tailwind 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 从网页生成 Pinterest Pin 草稿，浏览已连接的账户、画板、画板列表和分区，创建和管理画板，按主题研究公开的 Pinterest 群组画板，查看草稿和推荐发布时间，检查账户订阅状态，管理已保存的关键词列表，安排 Pin 发布，编辑草稿和已排期 Pin 的文案，并删除尚未发布的 Pin。

payload.name: Ads by AdKit: Meta & Google
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AdKit connects your ad accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. 

Analyze campaign performance, create campaign drafts, research competitor ads, and generate ad creatives across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and Reddit Ads workflows. 

Changes stay draft-first for review and only publish after explicit approval, so ChatGPT can help you move faster without silently changing live campaigns.

payload.name: Twenty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Twenty helps users work with their CRM workspace from ChatGPT by discovering available tools, learning tool schemas, searching Twenty documentation, loading workspace skills, and executing permitted CRM actions such as finding, creating, updating, or deleting records and drafting or sending email when the user's role allows it.
payload.longDescription: Twenty 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 CRM 工作区：发现可用工具、了解工具架构、搜索 Twenty 文档、加载工作区技能，并执行获准的 CRM 操作，例如查找、创建、更新或删除记录，以及在用户角色获准时起草或发送电子邮件。

payload.name: Nifty
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Nifty to ChatGPT to analyze and organize your reselling business across every marketplace you sell on. ChatGPT can search and filter inventory, pull full item details and photos, check inventory health, manage favorites, private notes, and labels, review order history and expenses, edit items and update marketplace listings, and analyze sales, profit, and sell-through. Nifty unifies inventory and sales for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, and Whatnot.
payload.longDescription: 将 Nifty 连接到 ChatGPT，分析并整理你在各个市场经营的转售业务。ChatGPT 可以搜索和筛选库存，获取完整商品详情和照片，检查库存状况，管理收藏、私密备注和标签，查看订单历史和费用，编辑商品并更新市场列表，还能分析销售、利润和售罄率。Nifty 统一管理 eBay、Poshmark、Mercari、Depop、Etsy 和 Whatnot 上转售商的库存与销售。

payload.name: FullEnrich
payload.description: 查找 B2B 联系人和公司
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FullEnrich helps ChatGPT find and enrich B2B prospects. Search for the right people or companies, get verified emails and phone numbers, and build prospect lists without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: FullEnrich 帮助 ChatGPT 查找并补充 B2B 潜在客户信息。搜索合适的人士或公司，获取经过验证的电子邮件地址和电话号码，并在对话中直接建立潜在客户名单。

payload.name: Markifact - Ads & Analytics
payload.description: 运行 Google Ads、Meta 及其他 50 多个平台
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Markifact is a marketing automation and advertising management connector for ChatGPT. Built for marketers, agencies, media buyers, PPC specialists, growth teams, and in-house marketing teams who need cross-channel reporting, paid media analysis, and campaign management without switching between ad dashboards.

Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Snapchat Ads, Pinterest Ads, Amazon Ads, Apple Search Ads, OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT ads), Display & Video 360 (DV360), Spotify Ads, Data Manager.

Analytics and data: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Trends, Google Search, BigQuery, SEMrush, Adjust, Bing Webmaster Tools, PageSpeed Insights.

E-commerce and CRM: Shopify, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and Google Merchant Center.

Workspace and reporting: Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs, Google Drive, Microsoft SharePoint (OneDrive), Dropbox, Google Business Profile, and Google Maps.

Social and messaging: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Slack, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp.

Use Markifact for cross-channel advertising reports, PPC reporting, campaign audits, account monitoring, budget pacing, search term and keyword analysis, creative performance analysis, marketing data extraction, and campaign optimization. ChatGPT can retrieve campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences, budgets, conversions, performance metrics, dimensions, and account structures from any connected account.

Markifact also supports advertising automation. Create campaigns and ads, update budgets and bids, pause or enable campaigns, edit supported ad fields, upload images and video, manage targeting, and run other platform-supported actions, then send results straight to Google Sheets, Slides, Docs, or Slack.
payload.longDescription:
Markifact 是面向 ChatGPT 的营销自动化和广告管理连接器，服务营销人员、机构、媒体投放人员、PPC 专家、增长团队和内部营销团队，让他们无需在广告仪表板之间切换，即可进行跨渠道报告、付费媒体分析和活动管理。

广告平台：Google Ads、Meta Ads（Facebook 和 Instagram）、Microsoft Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、Reddit Ads、Snapchat Ads、Pinterest Ads、Amazon Ads、Apple Search Ads、OpenAI Ads（ChatGPT 广告）、Display & Video 360（DV360）、Spotify Ads、Data Manager。

分析和数据：Google Analytics 4（GA4）、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager（GTM）、Google Trends、Google Search、BigQuery、SEMrush、Adjust、Bing Webmaster Tools、PageSpeed Insights。

电商和 CRM：Shopify、HubSpot、Klaviyo 和 Google Merchant Center。

工作区和报告：Google Sheets、Google Slides、Google Docs、Google Drive、Microsoft SharePoint（OneDrive）、Dropbox、Google Business Profile 和 Google Maps。

社交和消息：Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn、Slack、Pinterest、YouTube、TikTok、WhatsApp。

使用 Markifact 进行跨渠道广告报告、PPC 报告、营销活动审计、账户监控、预算节奏控制、搜索词和关键词分析、创意表现分析、营销数据提取及营销活动优化。ChatGPT 可以从任何已连接账户中获取营销活动、广告组、广告、关键词、受众、预算、转化、表现指标、维度和账户结构。

Markifact 还支持广告自动化。创建营销活动和广告，更新预算和出价，暂停或启用活动，编辑受支持的广告字段，上传图片和视频，管理定向并执行其他平台支持的操作，然后将结果直接发送到 Google Sheets、Slides、Docs 或 Slack。

payload.name: GoDaddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Our app makes it easy to search for and buy available domains. Simply type in your idea and see what's available on GoDaddy.com right now. If your first choice is taken, we'll show you amazing alternatives. Best used for checking domain availability and exploring options you hadn't even thought of yet.
payload.longDescription: 我们的应用让你轻松搜索并购买可用域名。只需输入你的想法，就能查看 GoDaddy.com 当前可注册的域名。如果首选已被注册，我们会为你展示出色的替代选项。此应用尤其适合查询域名是否可用，并探索你可能尚未想到的其他选择。

payload.name: Windsor.ai Instagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Windsor.ai Instagram helps creators and marketers analyze live Instagram organic performance. Users can discover connected Instagram Business or Creator accounts, inspect valid fields and options, query account and media insights — followers, reach, impressions, profile and website clicks, and engagement — and connect the Instagram connector. It covers organic Instagram analytics only: it does not run write actions (Instagram publishing is not enabled), cover Instagram Ads (use the Meta Ads connector), or provide ad cost data. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription: Windsor.ai Instagram 帮助创作者和营销人员分析实时 Instagram 自然流量成效。用户可以发现已连接的 Instagram Business 或 Creator 账户，查看有效字段和选项，查询账户及媒体洞察数据——粉丝数、触达量、展示次数、个人资料和网站点击量、互动情况——并连接 Instagram 连接器。它仅涵盖 Instagram 自然流量分析：不执行写入操作（未启用 Instagram 发布功能）、不涵盖 Instagram Ads（请使用 Meta Ads 连接器），也不提供广告费用数据。Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Retell AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone calls for your business. Retell powers call center automation for receptionists, sales outreach, collections, customer support, and more. Use ChatGPT to create agent prompts, configure call transfers, edit settings, and deploy to live phone numbers - all conversationally.
payload.longDescription:
该插件构建并部署语音代理。以下功能和限制适用：
Build, deploy, and manage AI voice agents that handle phone calls for your business. Retell powers call center automation for receptionists, sales outreach, collections, customer support, and more. Use ChatGPT to create agent prompts, configure call transfers, edit settings, and deploy to live phone numbers - all conversationally.

payload.name: Infojobs Brasil
payload.description: 在 Infojobs Brasil 找工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Acesse milhares de vagas de emprego no Brasil diretamente do ChatGPT. Pesquise por palavra-chave e localização, filtre por tipo de contrato e salário. Visualize os resultados em cards interativos com informações completas de cada vaga: empresa, localização, salário e descrição. Clique para ver detalhes completos no Infojobs Brasil.
payload.longDescription: 直接通过 ChatGPT 搜索巴西数千个工作职位。按关键词和地点搜索，并按合同类型和薪资筛选。通过交互式卡片查看职位完整信息，包括公司、地点、薪资和职位描述。点击即可在 Infojobs Brasil 查看完整详情。

payload.name: PDF Editor by PDF net
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in ChatGPT. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.

Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.

Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.

Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.
payload.longDescription:
将pdf.net连接至ChatGPT，即可编辑、生成和整理PDF。
您的pdf.net资料库可直接连接——无需每次重新上传。

直接编辑PDF：修改文本、修复日期、填写表单。
通过提示生成新PDF——发票、合同、方案。
合并最多20个PDF，按页码范围拆分，压缩文件，并转换为Word、Excel或PowerPoint。
翻译整份文档的同时保留排版。
将资料库整理至文件夹中。

处理PDF时常常效率低下。
您需要转为Word编辑，换工具合并，额外付费翻译，还要在文件夹里翻找文件。pdf.net将所有功能整合至一个对话中。

直接编辑PDF——无需转至Word处理。
通过提示生成发票、合同和方案。
合并最多20个文件，按页码拆分，压缩文件，并转换为Word、Excel或PowerPoint。
翻译整份文档的同时保留排版。
您的pdf.net资料库保持连接，文件触手可及。

payload.name: iZap
payload.description: 管理 WhatsApp 企业业务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect iZap to manage your WhatsApp customer conversations without leaving the chat. Check how your day is going at a glance — message volume, how much your AI assistant is handling versus your team, and how long conversations are taking. Search and read your chat history, look up contacts, and send WhatsApp messages or approved templates on the spot. Launch broadcast campaigns with a preview step before anything goes out, and track their delivery. You can also set up and fine-tune the AI assistants that reply to your customers — create a new one or update its instructions in seconds.

Everything runs against your own authenticated iZap business, so you see your real numbers and your real conversations.
payload.longDescription:
连接 iZap，在聊天中管理 WhatsApp 客户对话。查看消息量、AI 助手与团队处理比例和对话时长；搜索和阅读历史、查找联系人、发送消息或已批准模板；预览后发起广播并跟踪送达；设置和微调回复客户的 AI 助手。所有操作都针对经过认证的

iZap 企业账户，显示真实数据和对话。

payload.name: Business Helper
payload.description: 有来源支持的商业答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source-
backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about strategy, product, marketing, or operations, the app enriches responses
with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it
clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally
without external references.

Business Helper 不收集个人数据，也不提供专业法律或财务建议。任何外部服务都只根据用户意图推荐。

payload.name: Namify
payload.description: 从创意到域名，即刻完成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.

What makes Namify different is that it doesn't stop at "is this domain free?" Every suggestion can be vetted for full brand-readiness: run a trademark check to spot legal conflicts, and a social-handle check to confirm the name is available across major platforms. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.
payload.longDescription:

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Zendrop helps ecommerce merchants manage dropshipping operations from ChatGPT. Users can search the Zendrop catalog, add and import products to connected stores, inspect store, order, billing, and performance data, update fulfillment and tracking settings, preview fulfillment costs, and confirm guarded order fulfillment, cancellation, address, and product-linking workflows.
payload.longDescription: Zendrop 帮助电商商家直接在 ChatGPT 中管理一件代发业务。用户可以搜索 Zendrop 商品目录、将商品添加并导入已连接的商店、查看商店、订单、账单和业绩数据、更新履约和物流跟踪设置、预览履约成本，并确认受保护的订单履约、取消、地址及商品关联流程。

payload.name: Seismic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Seismic MCP Connector for ChatGPT enables secure integration between ChatGPT and Seismic, allowing ChatGPT to generate accurate, Seismic-specific responses using approved sales and enablement content.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector provides authentication and scope-based access control, ensuring only authorized tools and content are available within ChatGPT.

To configure access, users must install the MCP Connector for ChatGPT app from Seismic Exchange, where tenant admins define scopes and permissions that control which Seismic capabilities are exposed.

Once configured:

ChatGPT connects to Seismic through the MCP server

Only approved tools and content are accessible

Responses are grounded in trusted, compliant materials

Without proper installation and scope configuration, Seismic tools will not be visible in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
适用于 ChatGPT 的 Seismic MCP Connector 可在 ChatGPT 与 Seismic 之间实现安全集成，让 ChatGPT 使用获批的销售和赋能内容生成准确、针对 Seismic 的回复。

该连接器基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 构建，提供身份验证和基于范围的访问控制，确保 ChatGPT 中仅开放获授权的工具和内容。

要配置访问权限，用户必须从 Seismic Exchange 安装适用于 ChatGPT 的 MCP Connector 应用；租户管理员会在其中定义要开放的 Seismic 功能范围及权限。

配置完成后：

ChatGPT 通过 MCP 服务器连接 Seismic

仅可访问获批的工具和内容

回复以可信、合规的材料为依据

如果没有正确安装和配置访问范围，Seismic 工具将不会在 ChatGPT 中显示。

payload.name: iubenda: Privacy compliance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language. Run cookie scans to detect trackers, then update your policies to match as your site changes. Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet GDPR, ePrivacy, US state privacy laws, and privacy requirements across markets, without the manual overhead.

payload.name: Ashby
payload.description: 分析招聘数据并采取行动
payload.summaryOriginal: Analyze and act on hiring data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts. Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat. Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

Try prompts like these:
“Summarize our current engineering pipeline, highlight bottlenecks, and identify at-risk candidates.”
"Consider [Candidate Name] for our open Staff Engineer role and move them to the recruiter screen stage."
“Generate a debrief summary for [Candidate Name] using interview feedback, scorecards, and recruiter notes.”
“Analyze time-to-fill trends across sales roles and summarize where delays are occurring.”
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 中的 Ashby 让你即时访问招聘流程、候选人资料、在招职位、面试及文字记录。提问、发现招聘趋势，并直接在聊天中添加备注、调整候选人所处阶段或发送邮件。Ashby 通过安全的用户级 OAuth，将 ChatGPT 连接到实时招聘数据。每项请求和操作都遵循你现有的权限，确保数据受到保护。

可以尝试以下提示词：
“总结我们当前的工程岗位招聘流程，指出瓶颈，并找出有流失风险的候选人。”
“考虑让 [候选人姓名] 应聘我们在招的 Staff Engineer 岗位，并将其移至招聘人员初筛阶段。”
“利用面试反馈、评分表和招聘人员备注，生成 [候选人姓名] 的面试复盘摘要。”
“分析销售岗位招聘周期的变化趋势，并总结延误发生在哪些环节。”

payload.name: AWeber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The AWeber MCP connects your AI assistant to your AWeber account, letting you manage email marketing through natural language. Instead of logging into AWeber, you can ask your assistant to manage subscribers, draft emails, analyze campaigns, and more — all through simple conversational requests.
payload.longDescription: AWeber MCP 将AI助手连接到你的 AWeber 账户，让你通过自然语言管理电子邮件营销。无需登录 AWeber，你可以通过简单的对话请求，让助手管理订阅者、起草邮件、分析营销活动，以及执行更多操作。

payload.name: Constant Contact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Go from email idea to a polished, ready-to-send campaign with the Constant Contact app. Describe the email you want, and the Constant Contact app will generate the HTML and render a live preview. Not quite right? Give feedback in chat, make edits, and preview again until it's exactly what you want. When you're ready to send, connect or create a Constant Contact account to import your email and reach your audience.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Constant Contact 应用，将邮件创意转化为精致且可直接发送的营销活动。描述你想要的邮件，Constant Contact 应用就会生成 HTML 并呈现实时预览。效果不理想？在聊天中提供反馈、进行修改并再次预览，直到完全符合你的要求。准备发送时，连接或创建 Constant Contact 账户，导入邮件并触达受众。

payload.name: Best Lawyers
payload.description: 搜索获同行认可的律师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for lawyers by practice area and location. Use the Best Lawyers directory to find peer-recognized attorneys by specialty (e.g. Corporate Law, Personal Injury), city, state, and country. Optionally filter to Lawyers of the Year. Results are based on Best Lawyers’ peer-review process.
payload.longDescription: 按执业领域和地点搜索律师。使用 Best Lawyers 目录，按专业（例如公司法、人身伤害）、城市、州和国家寻找获同行认可的律师。还可筛选年度律师。结果基于 Best Lawyers 的同行评审流程。

payload.name: Teamtailor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Teamtailor Public MCP lets authorized users search recruiting workspace data, inspect jobs, candidates, questions, organization structure and meeting records, and update job configuration, application questions, interview kits and skills from ChatGPT using the user's Teamtailor permissions.
payload.longDescription: Teamtailor Public MCP 允许获授权用户使用 ChatGPT 搜索招聘工作区数据、查看职位、候选人、问题、组织结构和会议记录，并根据用户的 Teamtailor 权限更新职位配置、申请问题、面试套件和技能。

payload.name: Apartments.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search millions of rental listings on Apartments.com directly from your conversation. Tell the assistant what you're looking for — city, neighborhood, price range, bedrooms, pet policy, amenities — and get curated results with photos, pricing, and availability in seconds. 

From a single chat you can explore floor plans, check unit availability, review fees and lease policies, get neighborhood insights, estimate affordability, schedule a tour, or contact a property directly.

No forms, no tab-switching, no scrolling through pages. Just describe your ideal home and let the assistant do the searching.
payload.longDescription:
直接在对话中搜索 Apartments.com 上数百万条租赁房源。告诉助手你的需求——城市、街区、价格范围、卧室数量、宠物政策、配套设施——几秒内即可获得精选结果，附照片、价格和可租情况。

在一次聊天中，你可以浏览户型图、查看房源可租情况、了解费用和租约政策、获取街区信息、估算负担能力、预约看房，或直接联系房源方。

无需填表、切换标签页或翻阅页面。只需描述理想的家，让助手帮你搜索。

payload.name: Atria
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atria helps users research advertisers and ad-library creative, compare connected ad-account performance, and use Radar to identify creative to scale or improve. Users can organize reference ads in shared boards, maintain their own brand profiles and competitors, read or produce video transcripts, generate brand-based ad images, and save notes in Atria. Transcription, image generation, and Radar recommendations can consume workspace AI credits.
payload.longDescription: Atria帮助用户研究广告主和广告资料库中的创意素材、比较已连接广告账户的表现，并使用Radar识别值得扩大投放或改进的素材。用户可以在共享看板中整理参考广告、维护自己的品牌资料和竞争对手、阅读或生成视频转写稿、生成基于品牌的广告图片，以及在Atria中保存笔记。转写、图片生成和Radar建议可能消耗工作空间AI额度。

payload.name: LinkedIn Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LinkedIn Ads helps advertisers turn every marketing dollar into business growth by making ad set performance easier to understand and act on. Understand what’s working. Build confidence. Make smarter marketing decisions—right where you already plan and analyze. Connect your LinkedIn Ads account with ChatGPT to get started.

This app is currently in beta and supports a limited set of LinkedIn Ads functionality. It provides read‑only access to ad set performance to help you understand results. Supported features and use cases may evolve as we expand tool coverage. 

In this beta, you can:
- View and search ad accounts and ad sets you have access to
- Ask natural-language questions about ad set and ad performance
- Break down metrics by date range, ad set, or ad

Ask questions like:
- "Show me all my active ad sets from account X"
- “How did my ad sets from account X perform last week?”
- “Which ads have the highest CTR in ad set Y?”
payload.longDescription:
LinkedIn Ads 帮助广告主让每一笔营销预算都推动业务增长，使广告组表现更易理解和采取行动。了解哪些做法有效，增强信心，在你已有的规划和分析位置做出更明智的营销决策。连接 LinkedIn Ads 账户与 ChatGPT 即可开始。

此应用目前处于测试阶段，仅支持有限的 LinkedIn Ads 功能。它提供广告组表现的只读访问，帮助你了解结果。随着工具覆盖范围扩大，支持的功能和用例可能会变化。

在测试阶段，你可以：
- 查看并搜索你有权访问的广告账户和广告组
- 用自然语言询问广告组和广告表现
- 按日期范围、广告组或广告拆分指标

可询问：
- “显示账户 X 中所有活跃广告组”
- “账户 X 的广告组上周表现如何？”
- “广告组 Y 中哪些广告的 CTR 最高？”

payload.name: Jooble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jooble helps you quickly find job opportunities from thousands of sources worldwide. Search by keyword, location, or job type, and get relevant listings in seconds. Jooble makes job hunting faster, easier, and more organized, so you can focus on finding the right opportunity.
payload.longDescription: Jooble 帮助你从全球数千个来源快速查找工作机会。按关键词、地点或工作类型搜索，几秒钟即可获得相关职位列表。Jooble 让求职更快捷、轻松且有条理，让你专注于找到合适的机会。

payload.name: Monster Job Search
payload.description: 搜索数百万个实时职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tap into Monster’s massive job network natively within ChatGPT.

Instant Search: Find real-time roles in healthcare, transportation, tech, and more.
Smart Filters: Narrow down by location, remote status, or seniority just by asking.
Interactive Cards: View salary ranges and tap "Apply" to take the next step instantly.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中接入 Monster 庞大的职位网络。

即时搜索：查找医疗、交通、科技等领域的实时职位。
智能筛选：只需提出要求，即可按地点、远程办公状态或资历级别缩小范围。
互动卡片：查看薪资范围，并点击“Apply”立即继续申请。

payload.name: SiteGuru
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SiteGuru helps marketers optimize their website for SEO. It runs an extensive technical, link and content audit, and gets your keyword and visit data from Google. Combined, this gives you a prioritized SEO todo list, advanced rank tracking, and detailed insights into your site's SEO.
payload.longDescription: SiteGuru 帮助营销人员优化网站 SEO。它会进行全面的技术、链接和内容审计，并从 Google 获取关键词和访问量数据。结合这些信息，它会生成按优先级排列的 SEO 待办事项清单、高级排名追踪和详细的网站 SEO 洞察。

payload.name: Highspot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Highspot helps users find and summarize sales content, answer CRM deal and go-to-market questions, get recommendations, and create or update pitches, Digital Rooms, and roleplay scenarios from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Highspot 帮助用户查找并总结销售内容，回答 CRM 交易和市场进入问题，获取建议，并在 ChatGPT 中创建或更新推介、Digital Rooms 和角色扮演场景。

payload.name: Adobe Marketing Agent
payload.description: 来自 Adobe 的营销洞察
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Adobe Marketing Agent for ChatGPT Enterprise lets you interact with Adobe Experience Platform AI Agents using natural language. Ask questions, get insights, and take action without leaving your workflow. It understands your intent and connects with Adobe solutions like Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics to deliver answers that help teams move faster and work smarter. In order to use this app an Adobe account is required, please reach out to Adobe administrator in your organization.

Language Support: AI Assistant is currently supported in English only. Non-English inputs may produce inconsistent or erroneous results.

Personal Data: If you include personal data in your prompts, only add what's necessary and only if you have the right to use it.
payload.longDescription:
面向 ChatGPT Enterprise 的 Adobe Marketing Agent 让你使用自然语言与 Adobe Experience Platform AI Agents 互动。无需离开工作流程，即可提问、获取洞察并采取行动。它理解你的意图，并连接 Real-Time CDP、Journey Optimizer 和 Customer Journey Analytics 等 Adobe 解决方案，提供有助于团队更快、更智能地工作的答案。使用此应用需要 Adobe 账户，请联系你所在组织的 Adobe 管理员。

语言支持：AI Assistant 目前仅支持英语。非英语输入可能产生不一致或错误的结果。

个人数据：如果在提示词中包含个人数据，请仅添加必要内容，并且仅在你有权使用这些数据时添加。

payload.name: Peach for WhatsApp Business
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT directly to your WhatsApp Business API to orchestrate messaging, build trigger-based workflows, and deploy customer-facing AI agents. With the Peach MCP integration, ChatGPT gets administrative and operational tools for your authenticated WhatsApp Business channel: read conversations and message history, send templates and app messages, manage media, schedule targeted broadcasts, build AI support agents, react to Shopify events, route conversations, manage official Meta WhatsApp templates, and keep contacts and pipeline stages up to date from WhatsApp interactions. Turn your WhatsApp number into an active, automated operating system managed directly inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 WhatsApp Business API，以编排消息、构建基于触发器的工作流并部署面向客户的 AI 代理。通过 Peach MCP 集成，ChatGPT 可为已认证的 WhatsApp Business 渠道提供管理和运营工具：读取对话和消息历史，发送模板及应用消息，管理媒体，安排定向群发，构建 AI 支持代理，响应 Shopify 事件，路由对话，管理 Meta 官方 WhatsApp 模板，并根据 WhatsApp 互动更新联系人和销售管道阶段。把你的 WhatsApp 号码变成可在 ChatGPT 内直接管理的活跃自动化运营系统。

payload.name: OnePageCRM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into your CRM assistant. It can summarize your Action Stream, do research, create new contacts, schedule follow-ups, rearrange overdue tasks, log notes after calls, update deals, and build simple dashboards. Let AI handle the admin while you build relationships, close deals, and focus on growing your business with OnePageCRM.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 变成你的 CRM 助手。它可以总结 Action Stream、开展研究、创建联系人、安排跟进、重新安排逾期任务、记录通话后的备注、更新交易并构建简单仪表板。让 AI 处理管理工作，你可以用 OnePageCRM 建立关系、完成交易并专注于发展业务。

payload.name: Process Documentation AI
payload.description: 由 Tallyfy 提供的免费工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Free AI tool that documents any business process or workflow. Describe your process in plain English and receive an execution-ready procedure with: structured sections, numbered steps, role assignments (who does what), deadline guidance, task type classification, and a separate Tallyfy automation section explaining how to make the process self-running. Output is a downloadable Word document with a marketing preamble and a back-page CTA to sign up at tallyfy.com/start for free, upload the document, and convert it into a live trackable workflow. No sign-up or account required to use this tool. Perfect for documenting SOPs, hiring workflows, customer onboarding, vendor approval chains, expense procedures, incident response runbooks, and any other repeatable business process. Built by Tallyfy, a workflow automation platform for teams.
payload.longDescription: 免费 AI 工具，可记录任何业务流程或工作流。用通俗英语描述流程，即可获得可执行程序：结构化章节、编号步骤、角色分工、截止日期指导、任务类型分类，以及单独的 Tallyfy 自动化章节，说明如何让流程自动运行。输出为可下载 Word 文档，含营销前言和末页 CTA，邀请用户在 tallyfy.com/start 免费注册、上传文档并转换为可跟踪工作流。使用此工具无需注册或账户。适合记录 SOP、招聘流程、客户入职、供应商审批、费用流程、事故响应运行手册及其他可重复业务流程。由工作流自动化平台 Tallyfy 构建。

payload.name: GoVeda Patent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoVeda Patent helps users search global patent records, retrieve and compare patent content, locate relevant passages inside long patents, find prior art for known patents, and generate AI-assisted novelty reports.

Use it for patentability review, freedom-to-operate research, or patent landscape exploration. Results can include ranked patent matches, abstracts, claims, descriptions, dates, parties, current legal status, legal-event history, citations, family data, CPC/IPC classifications, and standardized assignee names.
payload.longDescription:
GoVeda Patent 帮助用户搜索全球专利记录、提取并比较专利内容、定位长篇专利中的相关段落、为已知专利查找现有技术，并生成 AI 辅助的新颖性报告。

可用于可专利性审查、自由实施研究或专利版图探索。结果可以包括排序后的专利匹配项、摘要、权利要求、说明书、日期、相关方、当前法律状态、法律事件历史、引文、专利族数据、CPC/IPC 分类以及规范化的受让人名称。

payload.name: SEO Keywords by VibeSEO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VibeSEO helps website owners with keyword and competitor research, Google Search Console monitoring, technical site audits, and AI-assisted blog idea generation, drafting, approval, and scheduling — all scoped to the user's projects inside VibeSEO.
payload.longDescription: VibeSEO帮助网站所有者进行关键词和竞争对手研究、Google搜索控制台监控、技术站点审计，以及AI辅助的博客创意生成、撰写、审批和排期——所有功能均在VibeSEO内部用户项目范围内使用。

payload.name: Articulate
payload.description: 利用 AI 创建互动培训
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connects ChatGPT to Articulate. Describe the training you're creating: topic, goals, who it's for, and how in-depth it should be. Then open and review the outline created for you in Articulate, and generate the full content for your interactive training. You can also search and browse your existing courses.

Key use cases:

- Create a course outline
- Create a training package outline
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Articulate。描述你正在创建的培训：主题、目标、面向人群，以及应深入到什么程度。然后在 Articulate 中打开并审阅为你生成的大纲，生成互动培训的完整内容。你还可以搜索和浏览现有课程。

主要应用场景：

- 创建课程大纲
- 创建培训包大纲

payload.name: AI Proposal Maker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Proposal Maker turns what you draft in chat into a branded, sendable client proposal. Describe the project and your price, and it lays out a professional document with a cover, scope, and pricing. Get a shareable hosted link the moment it's ready, download a polished PDF, or publish a branded link you can track when the client opens it. Works for quotes and statements of work too. No account needed to start.
payload.longDescription: AI Proposal Maker 将你在聊天中起草的内容转为带品牌标识、可发送给客户的提案。描述项目和价格，它就会排版出包含封面、工作范围和定价的专业文档。完成后立即获取可分享的托管链接、下载精美 PDF，或发布带品牌标识的链接，跟踪客户何时打开。也适用于报价和工作说明书。开始使用无需账号。

payload.name: Certifier
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Certifier is a digital credentials platform that enables you to create, manage, and verify digital certificates and badges at scale.
payload.longDescription: Certifier 是一个数字凭证平台，支持大规模创建、管理和验证数字证书与徽章。

payload.name: Ocoya
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ocoya helps users inspect social profiles and posts, create AI-assisted drafts and campaigns, schedule or publish social content, and manage automation workflows from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 查看社交媒体资料和帖子、创建 AI 辅助草稿与营销活动、安排或发布社交内容，并管理自动化工作流程。

payload.name: Streak
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Streak is a CRM built directly into Gmail, so you can track deals, contacts, and workflows from your inbox.

Emails are logged automatically, pipelines update as conversations move forward, and notes and tasks stay attached to the work they belong to—without copying data into another tool.

Designed for teams and individuals who manage sales, partnerships, or customer relationships primarily over email and want a clear, up-to-date view of their work.
payload.longDescription:
Streak 是直接集成在 Gmail 中的 CRM，可让你在收件箱中跟踪交易、联系人和工作流。

邮件会自动记录，对话推进时销售管道也会更新，笔记和任务会关联到相应工作，无需将数据复制到其他工具。

适合主要通过电子邮件管理销售、合作关系或客户关系的团队和个人，帮助他们清晰、及时地掌握工作进展。

payload.name: Pylon
payload.description: 管理 Pylon 支持问题
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access Pylon's customer support platform directly from ChatGPT to search, manage, and resolve
customer issues. Stay on top of your support queue while connecting ChatGPT's insights to real customer conversations.

You can use the Pylon app to:
  • Check your queue: "What Pylon issues are assigned to me that need a response?"
  • Research customers: "Summarize recent issues from Acme Corp and flag any escalations."
  • Update issues: "Mark the billing issue from Sarah as resolved and add a note that we issued a refund."
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中访问 Pylon 客户支持平台，以搜索、管理和解决客户问题。随时掌握支持队列，并将 ChatGPT 的洞察与真实客户对话联系起来。

你可以使用 Pylon 应用：
  • 检查队列：“分配给我且需要回复的 Pylon 问题有哪些？”
  • 了解客户：“总结 Acme Corp 最近的问题，并标记任何升级事项。”
  • 更新问题：“将 Sarah 的账单问题标记为已解决，并添加我们已退款的备注。”

payload.name: tool4seller
payload.description: 亚马逊分析与广告工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tool4seller helps Amazon sellers inspect their authorized store, sales, profit, inventory, review, inbound shipment, advertising, and sales traffic data directly in ChatGPT. The app provides read-only business analytics so users can ask operational questions, compare performance, and review marketplace status without changing account data.
payload.longDescription: Tool4seller帮助亚马逊卖家在ChatGPT中直接查看授权店铺的销售、利润、库存、评价、入库运输、广告及销售流量数据。该应用提供只读业务分析功能，用户可提出运营问题、对比表现数据并查看市场状态，而无需更改账户信息。

payload.name: Quickchat AI
payload.description: 构建和管理 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Quickchat AI lets people build, configure, deploy, test and improve their own customer-support AI Agents without leaving ChatGPT. Set an Agent up from a website or from a short interview, manage its knowledge base and its HTTP and remote MCP Actions, put it on channels, try it in chat, triage and resolve Inbox conversations, and review performance, ratings, CSAT and AI credit usage.
payload.longDescription: Quickchat AI 可让用户无需离开 ChatGPT，即可构建、配置、部署、测试和改进自己的客户支持 AI 智能体。可以从网站或简短访谈开始设置智能体，管理其知识库以及 HTTP 和远程 MCP 操作，将其接入各个渠道，在聊天中试用，分流并解决收件箱对话，还可查看表现、评分、CSAT 和 AI 额度使用量。

payload.name: DataForB2B
payload.description: 寻找潜在客户、人才和 LinkedIn 信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DataForB2B helps sales, recruiting, and GTM teams with sales prospecting, candidate sourcing, talent mapping, and B2B data enrichment. It finds leads and candidates, surfaces funding rounds and hiring signals, searches jobs and LinkedIn or other social posts, and retrieves available work emails and contact details to prepare outreach.
payload.longDescription: DataForB2B 为销售、招聘和 GTM 团队提供销售拓客、候选人搜寻、人才地图绘制和 B2B 数据丰富功能。它可以查找潜在客户和候选人，展示融资轮次和招聘信号，搜索职位以及 LinkedIn 或其他社交媒体帖子，并获取可用的工作邮箱和联系方式以准备外联。

payload.name: Affinity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your Affinity data into ChatGPT to search contacts, companies, and deals; prep for meetings using your actual notes and interaction history; and update records as deals progress. Every email captured, every meeting logged, every relationship scored by your firm is now available directly in the conversation.
payload.longDescription: 将 Affinity 数据带入 ChatGPT，搜索联系人、公司和交易；利用真实笔记和互动历史为会议做准备；随着交易推进更新记录。公司收集的每封电子邮件、记录的每次会议、评分的每段关系，如今都可以直接在对话中访问。

payload.name: SeekOut
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search SeekOut's talent database, inspect candidate profiles, compare talent markets, discover companies, and manage recruiting workflows from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中搜索 SeekOut 人才数据库、查看候选人资料、比较人才市场、发现公司并管理招聘工作流。

payload.name: Nitrosend - AI Email Marketing
payload.description: 电子邮件营销与新闻通讯
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nitrosend is the AI-native email marketing platform. Connect it to ChatGPT and control your entire email stack through conversation.

What you can do:
- Create and send email campaigns with GPT/Codex written copy
- Build automation flows (welcome series, onboarding, win-back, cart abandonment)
- Send transactional email (password resets, receipts, verification)
- Manage contacts, lists, and segments
- Monitor email analytics and get improvement recommendations
- Design emails that match your brand automatically

Nitrosend learns your brand voice and gets smarter with every send. Bring your own sending infrastructure (SendGrid, SES, Postmark, Resend) or use ours. Unlimited contacts on every plan.

Built by the team behind SmartrMail (10 billion emails, acquired 2022) and Sendicate (28,000 users).

Get started: sign up at app.nitrosend.com, then connect Nitrosend from the ChatGPT App Directory.
payload.longDescription:
Nitrosend是原生AI电子邮件营销平台。将其连接到ChatGPT，通过对话控制整个电子邮件栈。

您可以实现以下操作：
- 使用GPT/Codex撰写的文案创建并发送电子邮件活动
- 构建自动化流程（欢迎系列、引导流程、客户召回、购物车弃单提醒）
- 发送交易邮件（密码重置、收据、验证信息）
- 管理联系人、邮件列表和用户分组
- 监控电子邮件分析并获取优化建议
- 自动设计符合品牌调性的邮件

Nitrosend会学习您的品牌语音，并在每次发送中持续进化。您可以使用自有的发送基础设施（SendGrid、SES、Postmark、Resend）或直接使用我们的服务。所有计划均支持无限联系人。

由SmartrMail（发送了1000亿封邮件，2022年被收购）和Sendicate（28,000名用户）团队打造。

立即开始：访问app.nitrosend.com注册账号，然后从ChatGPT应用目录中连接Nitrosend。

payload.name: Flodesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flodesk helps users analyze email, subscriber, segment, workflow, form, and checkout performance; inspect and manage subscriber profiles and segment membership; and create reusable audience segments through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Flodesk 帮助用户分析电子邮件、订阅者、细分群体、工作流、表单和结账表现；查看并管理订阅者档案及其所属细分群体；并通过 ChatGPT 创建可重复使用的受众细分群体。

payload.name: Hellowork
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trouvez un emploi rapidement, facilement, et à proximité grâce à l’application Hellowork pour ChatGPT.

Chaque jour, c'est 8 000 candidats qui trouvent un nouveau job grâce à Hellowork. De nombreuses offres d’emploi sont disponibles chaque mois, partout en France, dans tous les secteurs d’activité. Que vous recherchiez un CDI, un CDD, une alternance, un stage ou une mission d’intérim, Hellowork vous accompagne à chaque étape pour trouver un job adapté à votre profil.

Avec l'application Hellowork pour ChatGPT, vous pouvez :
- Rechercher des offres d'emploi en fonction du métier et de la localité que vous souhaitez
- Ajuster votre recherche en fonction du type de contrat, salaire, possibilité de télétravail
- Consulter le détail des offres qui vous correspondent et demander des précisions sur les offres, directement dans le chat
- Cliquer sur "Voir l'offre" pour postuler directement sur Hellowork
payload.longDescription:
Grâce à l’application Hellowork pour ChatGPT, trouvez rapidement et facilement un emploi près de chez vous.

Chaque jour, 8 000 candidats trouvent un nouvel emploi grâce à Hellowork. De nombreuses offres sont publiées chaque mois partout en France et dans tous les secteurs. payload.name: Insurance GPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Insurance-GPT is an AI-powered assistant designed to support insurance operations through a conversational interface. It helps users create proposals, manage policy information, handle claims, and process risk and coverage data efficiently. By automating insurance workflows and simplifying complex data handling, Insurance-GPT improves speed, accuracy, and user experience in insurance management.
payload.longDescription: Insurance-GPT 是一款由 AI 驱动的助手，通过对话界面支持保险运营。它帮助用户创建方案、管理保单信息、处理理赔，并高效处理风险和承保数据。通过自动化保险工作流并简化复杂数据处理，Insurance-GPT 可提升保险管理的速度、准确性和用户体验。

payload.name: ServiceM8
payload.description: 自动化管理技工服务业务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ServiceM8 is the app for trade contractors & home service professionals, with everything in one place to help you effortlessly manage your jobs, technicians & clients — job cards, scheduling, time tracking, staff GPS, client emails & SMS, job photos, online bookings, quotes, invoices, payments & more. ServiceM8 helps you cut paperwork, get more jobs done & provide amazing customer service.
payload.longDescription: ServiceM8 是面向维修承包商和家庭服务专业人士的应用，提供一站式工具，帮助你轻松管理工作、技术人员和客户，包括工作单、排期、工时追踪、员工 GPS 定位、客户电子邮件和短信、工作照片、在线预约、报价、发票、付款等。ServiceM8 帮助你减少文书工作、完成更多任务，并提供出色的客户服务。

payload.name: Amplemarket
payload.description: 寻找、研究和联系潜在客户
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to Amplemarket to prospect, enrich, research, and engage — all through ChatGPT. Search for people using filters like title, seniority, industry, company size, and location. Enrich people and companies for detailed profiles, tech stacks, funding history, and contact information. Look up contacts or accounts and their engagement history. Create and manage lead lists, add leads to sequences, and more.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Amplemarket，通过 ChatGPT 寻找潜在客户、补全数据、开展研究和互动。按职位、职级、行业、公司规模和地点等条件搜索人员。补全人员和公司数据，获取详细资料、技术栈、融资历史及联系方式。查询联系人或客户公司及其互动历史。创建和管理潜在客户名单，将潜在客户加入联络序列，以及更多操作。

payload.name: Keyword.com
payload.description: 追踪 SEO 和 AEO 可见度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your Keyword.com SEO and AI Visibility data into ChatGPT. Analyze rankings, uncover keyword opportunities, monitor SERP movements, compare competitors, track share of voice, and understand how your brand appears across Google and AI search.
payload.longDescription: 将你的 Keyword.com SEO 和 AI 可见度数据引入 ChatGPT。分析排名、发现关键词机会、监控 SERP 变化、比较竞争对手、追踪声量份额，并了解品牌在 Google 和 AI 搜索中的呈现方式。

payload.name: Vanta
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vanta helps users review compliance tests, controls, evidence, policies, risks, vendors, audits, personnel, access reviews, and vulnerabilities in ChatGPT. Supported workflows include managing tests and controls, uploading and evaluating evidence, creating and deleting policies, updating risk and vendor records, configuring SLAs, and managing AI governance records, questionnaires, and knowledge base resources. Users can also create tickets in connected services and manage privacy requests. Policy approval and privacy workflows can send notifications, and knowledge base resources can be published to the Trust Center. Available tools depend on the connected organization's enabled features and the user's permissions.
payload.longDescription: Vanta 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中审查合规性测试、控制措施、证据、政策、风险、供应商、审计、人员、访问审查和漏洞。支持的工作流程包括管理测试和控制措施、上传和评估证据、创建和删除政策、更新风险及供应商记录、配置 SLA，以及管理 AI 治理记录、问卷和知识库资源。用户还可以在已连接的服务中创建工单并管理隐私请求。政策审批和隐私工作流程可能会发送通知，知识库资源也可以发布到 Trust Center。可用工具取决于所连接组织启用的功能以及用户的权限。

payload.name: Planable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planable is the social media management platform built for agency teams and multi-brand organizations. Connect ChatGPT to your Planable workspaces to draft posts directly into client accounts, pull pending approvals across all your clients at once, audit what's scheduled for the week, and generate client-ready performance reports from live analytics data. Everything stays in Planable — your drafts, your approvals, your content calendar. ChatGPT just makes the work faster.
payload.longDescription: Planable 是专为代理机构团队和多品牌组织打造的社交媒体管理平台。将 ChatGPT 连接到 Planable 工作区，即可直接在客户账户中起草帖子、一次性汇总所有客户待审批的内容、检查本周排期，并基于实时分析数据生成可直接交付客户的效果报告。所有内容都保留在 Planable 中——草稿、审批和内容日历。ChatGPT 只是让工作更高效。
